reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 10(a) contains a broad Vendor (Kubient) defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation running to Customer and its officers/agents, covering the Services, the Auction Platform, breach of any representation or warranty (which incorporates the express IP non-infringement warranty at p0033), and Kubient's or its subcontractors' acts or omissions.
Detection guidance triggers are not met: the Vendor indemnity is present, is not one-way in Customer's favour, and contains no IP carve-out, so 'missing' would be the wrong call.

Standard indemnification procedure is present at Section 11 (prompt notice with no-prejudice for delay, indemnitor control of defence/settlement with consent protection, cooperation at indemnitor's cost), and p0027 expressly carves indemnification out of the consequential-damages waiver, so the clause meets or exceeds the preferred position on the Vendor side.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs; the deterministic check ('vendor indemnity for IP infringement present') corroborates.

The only divergence noted (Customer's reciprocal rather than narrow indemnity) is accurately identified and reasonably not raised, since it mirrors Customer's existing Content/Properties responsibility and warranties and does not defeat the rule's core requirement.
